description.narrative: THE PROJECT INCLUDES: THE REHABILITATION OF APPROXIMATELY 1200 MILES OF EXISTING ROADS; THE IMPLEMENTATION OF A MAINTENANCE SYSTEM BASED ON CONTRACTING OUT INCLUDING TO MICROENTERPRISES MADE UP OF CURRENT MWT EMPLOYEES; AND INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING OF MWT, PARTICULARLY ITS ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE IN RESPONSE TO THE DEMANDS OF CONTRACTING OUT AND STRATEGIC PLANNING OF ROAD ADMINISTRATION.
